about: Web pages the quality set reads instead of the live web, so every run sees the same pages. A search gets the results of the first site whose `match` matches the query; a page is found by the longest URL prefix in any site's `pages`. Facts here are fixtures for the tests, not current information. The iPhone app's quality run serves the same pages.
